About · Ankara, Türkiye

About Glinker Group

An Ankara-based engineering and supply company. A solution partner for critical electrical infrastructure.

We do two things. We help owners of power assets see the condition of their equipment while it runs. And we link buyers of electrical materials with the Turkish manufacturers who make them.

The name says what we do: a linker.

01Two lines of work

Two lines. One way of working.

Line 1In strategic partnership with Megger

Online Monitoring

Continuous condition monitoring of power assets: power transformers, generators and motors, high-voltage cables, medium-voltage feeders, distribution transformers and supply points. Five technology groups, from partial discharge to asset performance management software.

Online Monitoring

Line 218+ years in electrical supply

Supply & Project Solutions

Electrical materials and project solutions matched with Turkish manufacturers. Glinker Group is not a manufacturer. The client deals with one contact, through three steps: Define, Build, Run.

03Trade Facilitator

One point of access between international buyers and Turkish manufacturers.

A Trade Facilitator stands between two parties who would benefit from working together and do not yet have a line to each other. It does not replace either. It makes the connection, and keeps it working.

04How we work

Three principles.

  1. 01

    One contact

    You deal with one contact. In supply, that contact carries the order, production follow-up, documents and logistics. In monitoring, the same contact carries the technical conversation. The branching happens on our side, not yours.

  2. 02

    The choice stays with you

    We are not a manufacturer and we are not tied to one. You receive a comparable proposal from matched manufacturers and you choose. In monitoring, the asset owner sets the limits and makes the decision; the measurement supports it.

  3. 03

    We say what a measurement cannot tell you

    Every method has a limit. A two-gas monitor is not a full dissolved gas analysis. A trend is not a failure date. Asset management software adds no new measurement. We state these limits on the page, next to the product, because a specification built on a misunderstanding costs more than a plain answer.
